credentials.name: GitHub PAT (avenstone-autofix-vm)
credentials.renewal_instructions: https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens — name: avenstone-autofix-vm, scope: avenstonekc/avenstone-app, perms: Contents R/W, Pull Requests R/W, Workflows R/W. After regenerating: update ~/github-token.txt on VM + git remote set-url with new token.

credentials.name: Vercel API token (avenstone-auto-fix-arc)
credentials.renewal_instructions: https://vercel.com/account/tokens — name: avenstone-auto-fix-arc, scope: project avenstone-app. After regenerating: update VERCEL_API_TOKEN in Supabase Vault + ~/avenstone-app/.env on VM.

credentials.name: Cloudflare tunnel cert.pem
credentials.renewal_instructions: On VM: cloudflared tunnel login. Browser auth, new cert.pem replaces old at ~/.cloudflared/cert.pem.
